```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)

# Set theme
theme_set(theme_light(base_size = 14))
```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| echo: false
#| include: false

# Define plot functions for each distribution

# Normal distribution
plot_normal <- function() {
  x <- seq(-4, 4, length.out = 200)
  df <- tibble(x = x, y = dnorm(x, mean = 0, sd = 1))

  ggplot(df, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
    geom_area(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_line(color = "darkblue", linewidth = 1.2) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = 0,
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "darkred",
      linewidth = 0.8
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Value",
      y = "Probability Density",
      title = "Normal(μ=0, σ=1)"
    ) +
    ylim(0, 0.45) +
    theme(
      plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2, "mm"),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA)
    )
}

# Poisson distribution
plot_poisson <- function() {
  x <- 0:15
  df <- tibble(x = x, y = dpois(x, lambda = 5))

  ggplot(df, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
    geom_col(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.7, width = 0.6, color = "darkblue") +
    labs(
      x = "Count",
      y = "Probability",
      title = "Poisson(λ=5)"
    ) +
    theme(
      plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2, "mm"),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA)
    )
}

# Binomial distribution
plot_binomial <- function() {
  x <- 0:30
  df <- tibble(x = x, y = dbinom(x, size = 30, prob = 0.5))

  ggplot(df, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
    geom_col(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.7, width = 0.6, color = "darkblue") +
    labs(
      x = "Number of Successes",
      y = "Probability",
      title = "Binomial(n=30, p=0.5)"
    ) +
    theme(
      plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2, "mm"),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA)
    )
}

# Gamma distribution
plot_gamma <- function() {
  x <- seq(0.01, 10, length.out = 200)
  df <- tibble(x = x, y = dgamma(x, shape = 2, rate = 1))

  ggplot(df, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
    geom_area(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_line(color = "darkblue", linewidth = 1.2) +
    labs(
      x = "Value",
      y = "Probability Density",
      title = "Gamma(shape=2, rate=1)"
    ) +
    xlim(0, 10) +
    theme(
      plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2, "mm"),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA)
    )
}

# Generate and save plots
p_normal <- plot_normal()
p_poisson <- plot_poisson()
p_binomial <- plot_binomial()
p_gamma <- plot_gamma()

# Create output directory if it doesn't exist
dir.create("images_summary", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# Save to output directory
ggsave(
  "images_summary/dist_normal.png",
  p_normal,
  width = 4.5,
  height = 3.5,
  dpi = 100
)
ggsave(
  "images_summary/dist_poisson.png",
  p_poisson,
  width = 4.5,
  height = 3.5,
  dpi = 100
)
ggsave(
  "images_summary/dist_binomial.png",
  p_binomial,
  width = 4.5,
  height = 3.5,
  dpi = 100
)
ggsave(
  "images_summary/dist_gamma.png",
  p_gamma,
  width = 4.5,
  height = 3.5,
  dpi = 100
)

invisible(NULL)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false

distributions_data <- tibble(
  Name = c(
    "**Normal**",
    "**Poisson**",
    "**Binomial**",
    "**Gamma**"
  ),
  Parameters = c(
    "μ (mean)<br>σ (std dev)",
    "λ (rate)",
    "n (trials)<br>p (probability)",
    "shape, rate"
  ),
  Description = c(
    "Bell-shaped, symmetric curve. Defined on $(-\\infty, +\\infty)$",
    "Discrete distribution. Counts peak at λ, decays exponentially",
    "Discrete distribution. Symmetric (p=0.5) or skewed (p≠0.5)",
    "Continuous, right-skewed. Always positive"
  ),
  Properties = c(
    "Symmetric, constant variance. Mean = μ, Variance = σ²",
    "Variance = Mean = λ. Suitable for rare events and counts",
    "Discrete (0, 1, ..., n). Variance = np(1-p)",
    "Right-skewed. Variance > Mean. Flexible shape"
  ),
  `Use Cases (Data Type)` = c(
    "Continuous data with no natural bounds (e.g., measurements, differences)",
    "Count data: number of events, abundance, occurrences",
    "Binary outcomes: presence/absence, success/failure, alive/dead",
    "Positive continuous: concentrations, biomass, time to event"
  ),
  Plot = c(
    "![](images_summary/dist_normal.png){width=250px height=200px}",
    "![](images_summary/dist_poisson.png){width=250px height=200px}",
    "![](images_summary/dist_binomial.png){width=250px height=200px}",
    "![](images_summary/dist_gamma.png){width=250px height=200px}"
  )
)

# Create the gt table
gt_table <- gt(distributions_data) %>%
  cols_width(
    Name ~ pct(12),
    Parameters ~ pct(12),
    Description ~ pct(18),
    Properties ~ pct(18),
    `Use Cases (Data Type)` ~ pct(18),
    Plot ~ pct(22)
  ) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.width = pct(100),
    heading.background.color = "#e8e8e8",
    column_labels.background.color = "#f5f5f5",
    table.border.top.style = "solid",
    table.border.bottom.style = "solid",
    table.border.top.color = "#999",
    table.border.bottom.color = "#999",
    table.font.size = "12px"
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(align = "left", v_align = "top", size = "12px"),
    locations = cells_body()
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold", size = "12px"),
    locations = cells_column_labels()
  ) %>%
  tab_source_note(
    source_note = md(
      "Standard distributions used in Generalized Linear Models (GLMs) and linear regression"
    )
  ) %>%
  fmt_markdown(columns = everything())

gt_table
```
